badges.name: Pull Shark
badges.how: Open pull requests that get merged.
badges.tip: Small, focused PRs on projects already in use merge fastest.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: Pair Extraordinaire
badges.how: Get a pull request merged that has a co-author (Co-authored-by in the commit).
badges.tip: Add a "Co-authored-by: Name <email>" line to a commit before the PR merges.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: Galaxy Brain
badges.how: Replies marked as the accepted answer in GitHub Discussions.
badges.tip: Answer questions in other repos' Discussions; the asker must mark the reply as the answer.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: Starstruck
badges.how: Create a repository that gets starred by other people.
badges.tip: Polish the README and share the best repo; stars on a single repo are what count.

badges.name: Quickdraw
badges.how: Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it (own issues and PRs count).
badges.tip: Own issues and PRs count, so it just needs to be closed fast.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: YOLO
badges.how: Merge a pull request without a review.
badges.tip: Merge a PR without a review, e.g. in a repo you own.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: Public Sponsor
badges.how: Sponsor an open source project through GitHub Sponsors (publicly).
badges.tip: Sponsor any maintainer through GitHub Sponsors and keep it public.
badges.note: Work in private repositories can't be seen here. The panel on the right shows what GitHub has awarded.

badges.name: Mars 2020 Contributor
badges.how: Retired. Was given for contributing to a repo used by the 2020 Mars helicopter mission.

badges.name: Arctic Code Vault Contributor
badges.how: Retired. Was given for code archived in the 2020 Arctic Code Vault.

highlights.name: Developer Program Member
highlights.how: Member of the GitHub Developer Program.

highlights.name: Security Bug Bounty Hunter
highlights.how: Reported a security vulnerability through GitHub's bug bounty.

highlights.name: GitHub Campus Expert
highlights.how: Completed the GitHub Campus Experts program.

highlights.name: Security Advisory Credit
highlights.how: Credited on a GitHub security advisory.

highlights.name: GitHub Star
highlights.how: Named a GitHub Star by the community program.
